_doc: Part 6A.7 signal S2 — GSC impressions per geography and per (service, geo) tuple. Measured from the client's own 16-month Search Console export, not estimated.
source: Search Console Performance export, property https://www.kingofkingswindowcleaning.com/, 2025-05-13 to 2026-09-12 (488 days), Web search type, all countries.
export_caveat: GSC caps the query dimension at 1,000 rows. These totals cover 31,164 of the property's query impressions; the long tail below the cap is not represented, so a zero here means "not in the top 1,000 queries", not "provably zero".
interpretation_limit: GSC impressions measure THIS SITE'S exposure, not market demand. A market where the site has no page and no visibility reports near-zero by construction. That is precisely why Part 6A requires two signals: S4 (competitor coverage) catches geographies where demand demonstrably exists but this site is invisible.
